name: Password input
summary: Use the Password input when users need to enter a password, with an optional progressively enhanced control to show or hide it.
whenToUse: Use for a password used to create or access an account.
Use the show or hide control when seeing the entered value helps users prevent mistakes.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for a one-time security code, memorable answer or other value that is not a password.
Do not prevent password managers or pasting into the field.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.description: A visible label is explicitly associated with the password field.

anatomy.name: Password field
anatomy.description: A type=password input uses suitable autocomplete, spelling and capitalisation attributes.

anatomy.name: Show or hide toggle
anatomy.description: A hidden-by-default button is revealed by GOV.UK JavaScript and controls the input.

anatomy.name: Hint and error
anatomy.description: Instructions and validation feedback are referenced with aria-describedby.

variants.name: Default
variants.use: A current or newly created password.

variants.name: Error
variants.use: A password field whose submitted value did not meet the stated requirement.

behaviour: Initialise the govuk-password-input module to reveal the toggle and switch the field type between password and text.
The toggle updates its visible label and accessible name between show and hide states.
Without JavaScript, the password field remains usable and the hidden toggle stays hidden.
accessibility: Use autocomplete=current-password for sign-in and autocomplete=new-password when creating or changing a password.
Keep the field label visible and associate hint or error ids through aria-describedby.
Allow browsers and assistive software to reveal, paste and fill passwords.
content: State password requirements before the field and describe only rules the service actually enforces.
Use “Show” and “Hide” toggle labels with accessible names that include “password”.
Error messages should identify the unmet requirement without reproducing the password.
